turns.goal: What food and campus facilities are near PSU Phuket?
turns.final_answer: PSU Phuket has a campus library, on-campus dormitories, sports facilities, a campus health service and a student canteen. Nearby food options include the campus canteen (about THB 50), Kathu food stalls 2 km away (about THB 60), and food courts and markets around 10–12 km away (about THB 80–100). These are sample details from public sources. If PSU Phuket feels right, tap “Choose” on its card and we’ll look at loan options next.
